result.instructions: Tools for Quartix, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Where are all our vehicles right now, and which ones are moving?"; "Show the trips of the van in the north depot last week, with distance and idling time."; "Which drivers had the lowest driving-style score this month?". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Quartix data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run quartix_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run quartix_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run quartix_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. quartix_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: quartix_list_regions
tools.title: List regions
tools.description: List the Quartix regions this account can see. Start here to find region ids for the filters. Quartix QWS: GET /api/regions.

tools.name: quartix_list_sites
tools.title: List sites
tools.description: List the sites (depots or offices) in a region, with their ids. Quartix QWS: GET /api/sites.

RegionID.description: Filter by Quartix region id (see quartix_list_regions).

tools.name: quartix_list_groups
tools.title: List groups
tools.description: List vehicle and driver groups, with the vehicles and drivers in each group. Quartix QWS: GET /api/groups.

RegionID.description: Filter by Quartix region id (see quartix_list_regions).

tools.name: quartix_list_vehicles
tools.title: List vehicles
tools.description: List vehicles with registration, description, group membership and time zone. Quartix QWS: GET /api/vehicles.

RegionID.description: Filter by Quartix region id (see quartix_list_regions).

tools.name: quartix_get_vehicle_positions
tools.title: Get latest vehicle positions
tools.description: Get the latest known position, speed, heading and last event of each vehicle. Live data: it is not cached. Quartix QWS: GET /api/vehicles/live.

RegionID.description: Filter by Quartix region id (see quartix_list_regions).

tools.name: quartix_list_drivers
tools.title: List drivers
tools.description: List drivers with name, initials, shift start time, time zone and groups. Quartix QWS: GET /api/drivers.

RegionID.description: Filter by Quartix region id (see quartix_list_regions).

tools.name: quartix_get_driver_positions
tools.title: Get latest driver positions
tools.description: Get the latest known vehicle, position and last event for each driver. Personal data, live: it is not cached. Quartix QWS: GET /api/drivers/live.

RegionID.description: Filter by Quartix region id (see quartix_list_regions).

tools.name: quartix_list_vehicle_trips
tools.title: List vehicle trips
tools.description: List trips of vehicles in a period: start and end time and place, distance, travel and idling time, speed and driving style if requested. Quartix QWS: GET /api/vehicles/trips.

RegionID.description: Filter by Quartix region id (see quartix_list_regions).

StartDay.description: First day of the period, as the vendor expects it (format not stated in the vendor reference).

EndDay.description: Last day of the period, as the vendor expects it.

StartDateTimeUTC.description: Start of the period, UTC date-time (ISO 8601).

EndDateTimeUTC.description: End of the period, UTC date-time (ISO 8601).

Include.description: Extra data to include, as the vendor names it (for example drivingStyle).

MostRecent.description: Return only the most recent N trips.
